description: Bug hunt 2026-11-28 W1: Fury Whirlwind was cast once per fight at 15-27 (guard reset only by Bloodthirst); now on its 3-turn cooldown when two or more enemies stand, and a Whirlwind on cooldown no longer wastes the turn.

edits.name: Fury Whirlwind on its cooldown: the old alternation guard was reset only by Bloodthirst (now a tier-7 talent), and a blocked branch ended the turn
edits.old: if (multi && h.skills.indexOf('whirlwind') !== -1 && h.lastMainRageSkill !== 'whirlwind' && !h.cd.whirlwind) { if (sk('whirlwind')) { if (!use(st, h, 'whirlwind')) return; aoe(st, h, 0.6, { weapon: true, skill: 'whirlwind' }); } return; }
edits.new: if (multi && sk('whirlwind')) { if (!use(st, h, 'whirlwind')) return; aoe(st, h, 0.6, { weapon: true, skill: 'whirlwind' }); return; }
